Commentary.Commentary: Sri Lanka started well, despite losing Dinesh Chandimal in the second over. Kusal Perera and Bhanuka Rajapaksa started slow but kept the boundaries rolling after that as they started looking settled. Bhanuka too could not go on for longer as he departed to Shamsi and Perera and Dhananjaya de Silva looked to steady things, but this stand was cut short too and from a position of 59/2, they slipped to 86/6, losing batters like dominoes. After this, they still kept losing wickets regularly and folded for just 103. Just 4 batters crossed the double-digit mark, in terms of runs and that speaks volumes regarding their display.

This has been a wonderful bowling display from the Proteas and they have restricted the hosts to a tame total of 103. Sri Lanka have also equaled their lowest total in T20Is and they will be disappointed with how they have fared with the bat. They did start off well but just kept losing wickets and never stitched a partnership which helped them rack up runs quickly and they will feel like they are around 30-35 runs short of what they would have wanted.

OUT! Trapped in front! The agony for the Sri Lankans is over. Maharaj delivers it flat and full on middle, going straight on after landing, Maheesh Theekshana tries to defend it with a straight bat but misses. The ball pings the pads, the appeal is made and the umpire agrees. Sri Lanka are bowled out for 103!
Flighted and on middle, Praveen Jayawickrama walks forward and flicks it to mid-wicket. It's a wicket maiden for Markam to finish his spell. 4-1-21-3, what a cracking effort!
Loopy around middle and leg, Praveen tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to the leg side.
Who will bowl the penultimate over?
Short and wide outside off, Praveen opens the face of his blade but finds the point fielder again.
Shortish and close to off, skidding away, Praveen Jayawickrama guides it through the line but finds backward point.
Fuller one, around leg, the debutant defends it ahead of his front pad.
Praveen Jayawickrama is the last batter in.

OUT! Caught and bowled! Wicket number 9 goes down and it's the big one of Charith Asalanka. Markram picks his third. Slower through the air, full and around off, Asalanka shapes up for a cover drive but it probably holds up from the surface. He is early into his shot and ends up chipping a simple return catch to the bowler.
Quicker and fuller on off, defended from the crease to the off side. Bjorn Fortuin is also done with his spell, 4-0-12-2. Amazing.
Aiden Markram to bowl out!

OUT! Chameera is a goner despite taking the DRS. A smart piece of bowling from Bjorn Fortuin. He comes up with a flatter arm ball around off and it skids on after landing. Chameera is caught on the back foot as he attempts to defend. Misses the ball and is struck on the pads. They appeal and the finger is up. Dushmantha Chameera takes the DRS but it's of no use.  Chameera is plumb. Three reds on the Ball Tracker. Sri Lanka lose their 8th wicket and are in danger of getting bowled out within the 20 overs.
Praveen Jayawickrama arrives at Number 10!
Walks forward and works it in the gap on the leg side for a run.
Review!
Loopy and around leg, Asalanka is forward as he tries to flick. But the ball takes the leading edge and loops up in the air. It falls safely at short mid-wicket.
Turn and bounce from around off, Charith Asalanka goes back to cut but it spins back in and cramps him for room. The ball takes the gloves and raps him on the pads.
Tossed up ball on middle, flicked on the leg side but straight to square leg.
Flatter and shorter on off, Asalanka pushes it down to long on for a single. 4-0-20-3, Shamsi has bowled out. Fantastic effort.
Fuller in length around off, Chameera drives it down to long off for a single.

Shout for an lbw! Sharp spin into the batsman, from around off, Dushmantha Chameera tries to defend but it beats the bat and pings him on the pads. The bowler is convinced as he appeals but nothing from the umpire. Shamsi gets no support from de Kock. Going down leg!
Will Bjorn Fortuin bowl out or will we see a bowling change?

OUT! That's an absolute beauty. Shamsi gets his third. Floated one, full and landing outside off, Chamika Karunaratne presses forward to drive it through the line but it curls back in sharply to take a bit of an inside edge and rattles the stumps behind. The third umpire checks for the no ball, both for the front foot and the back leg, but Tabraiz Shamsi is fine on both counts.
Dushmantha Chameera comes into the middle!
Spinning away from the batsman after landing around off, Charith plays it late and taps it down to point for one. 100 up!
Short in length and outside off, Charith goes deep inside the crease and pulls it to wide long on for two.
Quicker and flatter on off, an arm ball, Chamika goes back inside the crease and defends. Tidy stuff. 30 more legal balls left in the innings.
Fine stop! A full toss on middle, punched straight back and it's stopped brilliantly with a dive from Bjorn.
Beauty! Slower through the air, full and around off, spinning away, Karunaratne tries to defend but it turns past his blade.
Wide! Bjorn Fortuin loses his grip and serves it way wide outside off. Chamika Karunaratne leaves it.
Loopy and on middle, Asalanka clips it behind square leg and rotates the strike.
Flatter one, around middle and skidding in, it's knocked down to long on for one.
Play and a miss! Bjorn Fortuin bowls it short and wide outside off, Karunaratne gets back to cut but misses.
Markram pulls his length back and delivers it on middle, Chamika works it again in the gap at mid-wicket, only for a run this time. 7 from the over!
Chamika Karunaratne leans forward to a full ball and wrists it softly through mid-wicket for another brace.
Slightly short and on off, Charith moves back inside the crease and eases it through mid-wicket for one.
Quicker one, full and around leg, it's worked wide of short fine leg for a run.
Floated one, full and around off, Chamika Karunaratne is forward as he defends it back.
Flatter delivery on middle and leg, Chamika gets back and helps it through mid-wicket for a couple.
On middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Chamika Karunaratne is the new batter in!

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! The spinners of the Saffas are running through the batting lineup of the hosts and the sixth one falls! Bjorn Fortuin serves this quicker, flatter too, around off, it zips through after hitting the deck. Wanindu Hasaranga goes back and looks to slash this one away but misses and the ball goes onto hit the off pole. Fortuin gets his first and the Lankans are slipping further.
Fullish, outside off, sliced over cover-point for a single. They wanted another but it was not there to be taken. Just the single.
A touch short, on middle, Wanindu Hasaranga goes back and hooks this one to deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
A single as this is tapped towards backward point by Charith.
Full, on off, hit back to the bowler.
The googly, outside off, Hasaranga leans back and flashes but misses. 5 from Shamsi's 3rd over!
On middle again, pushed to the leg side for one.
On middle, Wanindu Hasaranga dances down and heaves this towards deep mid-wicket. The batters take two but Bjorn Fortuin misfields in the deep, which allows the batters to take the third.
Fuller, floated, wider outside off, Hasaranga looks to drive but the ball takes the underedge, takes de Kock's boot and goes to the leg side.
Floated, around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Shorter, around off, Charith looks to defend but the outside edge takes the ball past point for a run.
Flatter, around off, pushed away to the point region. Another successful over for the visitors!
Out walks Wanindu Hasaranga!

OUT! LBW! Markram strikes again and half the Sri Lankan side is back in the shed now. The review does not work out for Perera and he walks off, even before the Ball Tracker can come on, as after the replays show that there was no bat, he knows that this would be plumb. Fuller, loopy, around off, Perera gets low and looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad. An appeal and the finger goes up. Perera probably knows this is out but he opts for the review. Ball Tracker confirms his fears as it shows three reds. He was looking good out in the middle but he is not able to continue.
Full, on off, Kusal looks to dig this one out, but the ball takes the inside edge and hits him on his boot.
On the pads again, fuller, worked to the on side for one.
On the pads, nurdled to the short fine leg region for one.
Outside off, slapped past point for a single.
TWO BYES. Floated, landing outside off, spins away as Kusal Perera looks to have a poke but misses. De Kock fails to collect too and the batters take a couple.
A single as this is flicked through mid-wicket.
Around off, pushed away towards point.
WIDE. This is slipped down the leg side, Charith Asalanka misses his shot. Wide signalled.
Floated, on off, kept out.
The new man walks in.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! That is a brilliant comeback from Shamsi and that is a huge, huge wicket. Shamsi has the last laugh and he gives Shanaka a bit of a send-off. After getting hit for a big six, he removes Shanaka and South Africa are doing very well in this phase. Shamsi floats this one up, lands it around off, the ball lands and spins in as Dasun Shanaka comes down the track and looks to work this across the line, but he misses. The ball goes onto crash into the furniture behind. Sri Lanka in a spot of bother now!
SIX! Brilliant! This time, Shanaka connects well and gets a biggie! This is floated up, lands fuller, around off, Dasun Shanaka pumps this one over the long off fence this time.
A single as Dasun Shanaka flicks this through square leg. Just 5 from this over!
Flatter, on middle and leg, KP gets low and just tickles this towards short fine leg for a quick single.
Quicker, fuller, on middle, Dasun Shanaka comes down and hits this wide of the long on fielder. But, it will only be for a single.
On middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
Down the leg side, Perera looks to tuck but misses as the ball takes the pad and goes to the left of short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Loopy, on middle, milked to long on for one.
A top over by Shamsi! Just two runs and a wicket off it! On middle, flicked through square leg and Shanaka gets underway with a single!
Floated, on middle, spins in, Dasun nudges this but only to the short fine leg fielder.
Who walks out?

OUT! STUMPED! It does not take long for Shamsi to get a wicket and the third one falls. That was very well bowled and Shamsi is loving it! Tabraiz serves this slightly shorter, outside off, as he sees Dhananjaya de Silva dancing down the track. The ball lands and spins in, as de Silva fails to connect bat with ball. Quinton de Kock collects and breaks the stumps off in a flash and that is the end of de Silva's innings.
Commentary.Howout: st Quinton de Kock b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: Around off, hit to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full again, outside off, Perera brings out the reverse sweep but fails to connect again.
Shamsi starts with a floater, outside off, Perera prods ahead and looks to put bat on ball, but the ball spins away and evades the bat.
Change in bowling. Here's Tabraiz Shamsi!
On middle, Perera gets low and sweeps to the man at deep square leg for one. 6 off Maharaj's first over!
This is whipped nicely to the right of the deep square leg fielder for a couple of runs.
A touch flatter, on the pads, nudged through mid-wicket for one.
On the pads, tucked to short fine leg for a run.
Around off, hit hard down the ground towards long on for a run.
Flatter, around off, de Silva blocks this out.
Change.
Outside off, guided through short third man for one. Sri Lanka are at 52/2 at the end of the Powerplay!
On middle, dropped to the leg side for one.

SIX! Kusal Perera is showing no respect to Kagiso Rabada as he is taking him on! Again, on a length, closer to off, in the arc and Kusal Perera flexes his muscles and bangs this one over long on for a massive hit.
FOUR! BANG! That was hit ferociously by Perera. On a length, outside off, Kusal Perera makes room and smokes this one through mid off and the ball speeds away to the ropes.
Dhananjaya de Silva gets off the mark! Short of a length, around off, dabbed towards short third man for a single.
Back of a length, on off, tapped to the leg side for one.
The new man is in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Markram gets a wicket and Sri Lanka lose their second one. Bhanuka Rajapaksa was looking very good but he will be livid with himself as he gets himself out on a full toss. This should have been dispatched but he will have to walk back to the shed. A full toss, around off and middle, Bhanuka Rajapaksa skips down and only manages to hit this back towards Markram, who gets low, to his left, and pouches this.
On middle, defended out.
FOUR! A full toss and Bhanuka Rajapaksa does not miss out on this. This is bowled on the pads, Bhanuka Rajapaksa gets low and just sweeps this one over the short fine leg fielder and gets a boundary.

FOUR! Very well played. Bhanuka Rajapaksa has played a couple of confident strokes. Fuller, floated, around off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa moves to the off side and just lofts this one over the cover region for a boundary.
TWO WIDES. This is bowled down the leg side, Kusal looks to sweep but misses and the keeper fumbles too, which lets the batters take one.

NOT OUT! This was close but umpire's call on impact sees Kusal Perera survive. Markram floats this one up, lands it fuller around off, Perera skips down the track and looks to work this to the leg side but misses and gets pinged on the pad. An appeal but the umpire says no. Keshav Maharaj opts for the review. No bat on this, but Ball Tracker shows that the impact was umpire's call, even though the ball would have hit the stumps. Will remain not out.
Review time!
Floated, on the pads, nudged through mid-wicket for one.
Aiden Markram to roll his arm now!
A touch short, outside off, Bhanuka looks to pull but gets the top edge towards third man for a single.

Looks like the rain has eased off and we are ready to get the action underway again! The South African players make their way out and the batters of Sri Lanka follow them out too. Anrich Nortje will complete his over now.

Update 7.19 pm local (1.49 pm GMT) - Uh oh! Looks like we spoke too soon. The rain has come back for second servings and this time, it is slightly heavier, than it was the last time. The groundsmen come out and the covers are spread out as well. Let's hope that it is just a passing shower and we continue soon. Looks like the covers are being taken off now. Does not look like we will be having too much of a delay.

This time, Bhanuka Rajapaksa moves leg side and looks to cut this shortish ball to the off side, but the ball flashes over his blade and goes to the keeper. Some words exchanged between Bhanuka Rajapaksa and Anrich Nortje too!
Hits the deck hard and around off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa goes back and looks to slash it away but again misses his shot.
Shortish, outside off, Bhanuka looks to play this late but misses again.
A slower length ball, outside off, Bhanuka looks to cut but gets beaten by the lack of pace.

It was drizzling in the middle and the groundsmen have run out into the middle. But, by the time they come into the middle, the drizzle has eased down by a lot. The umpires decide that they will continue playing and the players get back into position.
Around off, hit towards the mid off fielder for a single.
SIX! WOW! That was very well hit. A confident shot. On a length again, around off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa makes room and just tonks this one over the extra cover fielder for a biggie.

FOUR! Bhanuka Rajapaksa gets off the mark with a boundary! A good shot by him! A short ball, around off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa powers this one towards fine leg. Aiden Markram runs to his right in the deep, but the ball bounces just before the ropes and goes past as well.
Length around off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa pushes this to the left of the cover fielder, who stops the ball well.

Quick run! A slower back-of-a-length delivery on off, KP taps this to the leg side and scampers through for the run. The fielder fires a throw at the non-striker's end and hits too, but Perera was well in.
FOUR! That was a cracking hit! The first boundary of the game! On a length, around off, in the slot too, Kusal Perera muscles this one over the mid on fielder and the ball finds its way to the ropes.
Shortish, on off, KP punches this, but only finds the point fielder.
Bhanuka Rajapaksa walks out!

OUT! CAUGHT! Number one down and Nortje strikes in his first over! An easy take for the fielder and the Saffas have drawn first blood. Anrich serves a slower bouncer, around off, Chandimal lines up to play the pull shot, but only manages to flat-bat it towards the mid on fielder. Keshav Maharaj, the skipper, gulps this one down easily, by moving to his right. Nortje is pumped and this is a great start by the Proteas!
Commentary.Howout: c Keshav Maharaj b Anrich Nortje

Commentary.Commentary: A touch short, pacy, on the body, Perera pulls this straight to the man at deep square leg for a run.
On a length, outside off, Dinesh Chandimal swings hard at this and the ball takes the outside edge and runs down to third man for one.
On a length, wider outside off, punched to the fielder at mid off for a quick single.
Shortish this time, outside off, Kusal slaps this behind point this time and collects a brace.
Nortje starts off with a length delivery on the pads, Chandimal flicks this aerially over square leg and the ball bounces just before the man in the deep. One run.
On the pads this time, Dinesh flicks this towards the man at square leg, who misfields and allows a run. 4 off the opening over!
Who will bowl now?
Dinesh Chandimal is off the mark with a couple! Quicker, darted on the pads, this is tucked through mid-wicket by Chandimal for a couple of runs.
This is again tossed up, fuller around off, Chandimal pushes this one back to the bowler.
Tossed up, around off, Dinesh only defends this one out.
This is darted on the pads, Dinesh looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Sri Lanka and Kusal Perera open their account on ball one! Bjorn Fortuin starts with a flatter ball, on the pads, Perera tucks this through mid-wicket and gets a run.

Right. We are done with all the pre-match formalities as the action is all set to begin. The South African players have already spread out on the field and the openers of Sri Lanka, Kusal Perera and Dinesh Chandimal make their way out too. Spin to begin the game as Bjorn Fortuin will roll his arm. Here we go...

Keshav Maharaj, the South African skipper, says that they wanted to bat first but this is a good wicket and hopes that they can restrict the Lankans to a low score. Informs that they have one change as Rassie van der Dussen comes in and David Miller misses out.

The Sri Lankan captain, Dasun Shanaka, says that batting first has an advantage and runs on the board always counts and that is the idea. Adds that they can do well in this game and they need to do better in the Powerplay. Informs that they have a couple of changes to their side.

PITCH REPORT - Farveez Maharoof says that the deck is pretty hard and it looks dry as well. Says that it will be tough for the batters when the ball gets old and is slightly used. Ends by saying that this is still a decent deck to bat on.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Kusal Perera (In place of Avishka Fernando), Dinesh Chandimal (WK), Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Dhananjaya de Silva, Charith Asalanka, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Chamika Karunaratne, Dushmantha Chameera, Praveen Jayawickrama (In place of Akila Dananjaya), Maheesh Theekshana.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (WK), Reeza Hendricks, Aiden Markram, Rassie van der Dussen (In place of David Miller), Heinrich Klaasen, Dwaine Pretorius, Kagiso Rabada, Keshav Maharaj (C), Bjorn Fortuin, Anrich Nortje, Tabraiz Shamsi.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and lands in the favor of Sri Lanka. They have elected to BAT first.

Hello and a warm welcome to the second T20I between Sri Lanka and South Africa. The first game between these two went the way of the Africans and they will head into this game with confidence on their side. They batted well and also bowled superbly and will look to replicate the same. The Lankans, on the other hand, will be on the back foot and will want to bounce back to winning ways as if they lose this clash, they will lose the series too. Let's hope that we have a close game of cricket. Toss and team news up in a bit.
... MATCH DAY ...
